Overview

Tashkent has a population of 2,500,000. Tashkent is a major city in Uzbekistan with a population of 2,500,000. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
